504
The Jetson switcher manages labeled Docker applications, exposes list/status/switch/stop/update and Python ensure_running, and restores the prior application through systemd and state.json. It deliberately manages only its own containers. Its documented operating assumption is that the managed application runs alone: other containers must not monopolize GPU memory, utilization, or bandwidth. This is a useful design boundary, not evidence of observed customer failures. Related Stretch AI code uses latest-observation ZeroMQ delivery, and an episode recorder that buffers images before writing and records git/config/session metadata. Recording throughput and provenance on Stretch 4 still need confirmation.

VOXL 2 integrated PX4 and ROS 2 companion flight workflow

ModalAI · 2026

Evidence ↗ Code ↗
VOXL 2 combines a QRB5165 application processor running Linux with PX4 on the sensors DSP (SLPI); a separate flight controller is optional. This split keeps flight-control firmware and Linux autonomy on distinct processors.
970972
VOXL SDK services, PX4 on SLPI and ROS 2 Foxy packages; voxl-mpa-to-ros2 converts camera, IMU, point-cloud and VIO data. The vendor documents SDK/PX4 version-dependent MicroDDS client names, so firmware and message packages must be paired.
970971
MPA services are systemd services enabled according to SKU configuration. PX4 starts its uXRCE-DDS client at boot in the documented SDK 1.8 setup. For flight logs, `voxl-logger.service` can record only while armed; alternatively `voxl-logger-auto` runs persistently, accepts start/stop/status/arm-trigger commands, creates one `logNNNN/` directory per trigger, and supports an auto-stop duration. Service changes can be inspected with `voxl-inspect-services` and investigated through the journal.
975980971
There are separate application and flight records. `voxl-logger` stores MPA samples under `/data/voxl-logger/` by default; camera images are lossless PNG for grayscale and JPG for color, with optional raw channels in `data.raw`. Triggered mode writes `logNNNN/` sessions with a note in `info.json`, plus configurable named pipes. PX4 ULog files are under `/data/px4/log`; the VOXL 2 defaults set `SDLOG_PROFILE=2083` (default, estimator replay, debug, and high-rate sensor sets). A host-side `voxl-logger-to-rosbag` package converts MPA logs into ROS topics.
